intro.label: Pocket
intro.body: Four-on-the-floor kick and 8th hats for two bars. Bass enters on beat 1 of bar 3 with long C roots — don’t rush it.

intro.label: Figure
intro.body: Lit pitches are C · G (C+G). They match the MIDI stem.

intro.label: Harmony
intro.body: Intro is C (I) — the same symbols as the main chord-name row. Bass roots those changes.

intro.label: Missable
intro.body: Easy miss in Intro (bars 0–3): ornamenting past the written line. Play the MIDI pocket before adding notes.

v1.label: Pocket
v1.body: Pop verse pocket: kick on every quarter, snare on 2 and 4. Bass is quarters and 8ths (root, fifth, octave), not funk 16ths.

v1.label: Figure
v1.body: Lit pitches are C · C · G (C+G). They match the MIDI stem.

v1.label: Harmony

v1.label: Missable

pre.label: Pocket
pre.body: Pre-chorus walks the chord: Dm arpeggio then G7 (the F on top is the 7th). Lock those quarters to the kick.

pre.label: Figure

pre.label: Harmony

pre.label: Missable

ch1.label: Pocket
ch1.body: Chorus hook: root on 1, octave pop on the last 16th of beat 1, fifth on 2. Changes are one bar each — C G Am F.

ch1.label: Figure
ch1.body: Lit pitches are C · C · G (C+G). They match the MIDI stem.

ch1.label: Harmony
ch1.body: Chorus is C (I) – G (V) – Am (vi) – F (IV) – C (I) – G (V) – Am (vi) – F (IV) — the same symbols as the main chord-name row. Bass roots those changes.
